scope: From the overseas student's seat: s 5 (overseas student, intending overseas student); ss 8(1), (2), 101(1) (whether a provider may offer the course); s 27 (at most half the tuition fees before the course begins, unless chosen or 25 weeks or less); ss 28, 29(1)-(6), 31 (the protected account for prepaid fees); s 19(1), (1A) (what the provider must report about the student and by when); ss 46A, 46D(2)-(6), 46B(4) (provider default and the 14-day obligation); s 49 (the TPS Director's placement options, 30 days to accept); ss 50A(2)-(5), 50B(1), (3), (4), 50C(1) (calls on the Overseas Students Tuition Fund); ss 47A, 47B, 47D, 47E (student default and the refund owed, by when, to whom); s 48 (recovering it as a debt). Out: registration (Part 2); the providers' other duties (ss 15-18, 21-21B, 26); the national code (Part 4); TPS levies, the OSTF's administration, the TPS Director and the Board (Parts 5A, 5B); sanctions, suspension certificates beyond s 101, monitoring and enforcement (Parts 6, 7); review (Part 7AA, open only to providers); offences' penalties; machinery (Parts 1, 8). Refund amounts are not computed (the agreement or the Minister's instrument); business days are not counted.
seat: the overseas student or intending overseas student (s 5)
